title: Population
description: Total population: the number of people of a country in a year, from the World Bank series SP.POP.TOTL.
caveats: Mid-year estimates; definitions of who is counted differ a little between countries.

title: GDP
description: Gross domestic product: the total value of goods and services a country produces in a year, in current US dollars (World Bank series NY.GDP.MKTP.CD).
caveats: Current prices, so not adjusted for inflation; converted to dollars, not corrected for price levels (not PPP).

title: GDP per person
description: GDP per person: GDP divided by the population of the same year, in current US dollars. Computed by this project from the two World Bank series; it is not a separate World Bank download.
caveats: Current prices, not inflation-adjusted, not PPP; an average, it says nothing about how income is shared.
